Emery Oleochemicals GmbH.note: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (via KLK Emmerich GmbH) acquired the Düsseldorf-based oleochemicals assets and business of Emery Oleochemicals GmbH in 2015 and integrated it into KLK Oleo.

Gulf Stabilizer Industries.note: Gulf Stabilizers Industries operates as a joint venture between Zamil Group and the SI Group.

Oxiris Chemicals S.A..note: Raschig GmbH acquired Oxiris Chemicals S.A. from ARQUES Industries AG in 2008.

Proquitec Indústria de Produtos Químicos.note: Proquitec operates as an independent company focused on manufacturing and distributing chemical products for the rubber and plastics industries.

Songwon Industrial Co., Ltd..note: Songwon Industrial Co., Ltd. is currently operating independently and has not been acquired, though its founding family explored a minority stake sale in 2023.

Trigon Antioxidants Pvt. Ltd..note: Trigon Antioxidants Pvt. Ltd. remains an active, independent entity owned and managed by its original founders.

Flexsys.note: One Rock Capital Partners acquired Eastman Chemical Company's tire additives business and rebranded it as Flexsys.
